scope: The inserted ground logarithm under the explicit middle bridge is now quantitatively bounded. For a fixed simultaneous q, let L(q)=sum_e norm(q_e-1) and c(q)=sum_e norm(q_e-1)^2. Exact first-order plaquette incidence gives abs(V(qU)-V(U))<=8*L(q). The constructed ground satisfies g(qU)<=exp(6*beta*L(q))*g(U), and its actual log increment has absolute value at most 6*beta*L(q). Under each actual middle bridge mu_vw, the expectation of logg(qU)+logg(qinv U)-2logg(U) equals the first-log-increment response between its density rho(U) and rho(qU). Hellinger response and the already-proved middle entropy budget imply that this expectation has absolute value at most B(q)=72*beta*L(q)*sqrt(beta*c(q)), uniformly in the endpoint pair. Exact profile disintegration retains the true endpoint/source weights and gives E_pi[sigma_f^2*pairedGroundGain]<=B(q)*loss(f). Actual row entropy weighted by row variance is therefore at most (18*beta*c(q)+B(q))*loss(f). The original full transfer on gauge-invariant sources obeys E_q(Pf)<=C(q)*(18*beta*c(q)+B(q))*loss(f), C(q)=2*(1+exp(4*beta*L(q))). This is a closed response-loss estimate with no uncontrolled profile-energy remainder in its right-hand side. For equal rotations at N links, B(q)^2=5184*beta^3*N*c(q)^2, so B(q)/c(q)=72*beta*sqrt(beta*N) when c(q)>0. This square-root link-count dependence and the l1-dependent prefactor remain; no volume-uniform physical Haar-form bound or contraction is concluded. The earlier signed profile-energy remainder is bypassed in this estimate, not bounded directly. Global coercivity, distant mixed-ground summability, physical scaling, continuum construction and all twelve full Clay obligations remain open.

proof.joint_first_difference: Trace difference is at most twice holonomy chord. Product variation bounds the chord by the sum of its four link displacements. Exact incidence counts each spatial link four times, giving abs(V(qU)-V(U))<=8*L(q), including small periods.
proof.ground_log_increment: The spatial-weight comparison costs exp(4*beta*L); the actual row partition costs exp(2*beta*L). Their exact relation to lambda*g gives exp(6*beta*L). Applying the comparison in both directions bounds the actual log-ground increment by 6*beta*L.
proof.finite_difference_integration_by_parts: Let h(U)=logg(qU)-logg(U). Haar translation gives E_rho[logg(qU)+logg(qinv U)-2logg(U)]=integral rho(U)*h(U)-integral rho(qU)*h(U). This is exact for every endpoint middle conditional.
proof.conditional_insertion_bound: The first increment h is in [-6*beta*L,6*beta*L]. Bounded-response entropy gives the squared insertion <=(12*beta*L)^2*D(rho||rho_q). The middle bound D<=36*beta*c yields 5184*beta^3*L^2*c and hence the explicit cap B=72*beta*L*sqrt(beta*c).
proof.actual_source_weight: Exact weighted-profile disintegration and positive endpoint squared-source weights turn the uniform conditional cap into E_pi[sigma_f^2*pairedGroundGain]<=B*loss. The endpoint source mass is exactly 2*loss; no source-range norm or endpoint independence is introduced.
proof.entropy_and_response: Integrate the actual paired row-entropy inequality with sigma_f^2, then use the weighted insertion cap and nonnegativity of the inverse entropy. The existing variance-sensitive pointwise response gives the stated closed response-loss bound. The original full transfer is bound explicitly for gauge-invariant f.
proof.scaling_check: For q_e=a at all N links, L^2=N*c exactly, so B^2=5184*beta^3*N*c^2. The bound improves the gain-cost scaling relative to the previous coarse l1-squared profile price, but is not uniformly sharper at every beta and direction; the prefactor C is unchanged.

decision: The previously uncontrolled middle log-ground insertion now has an explicit actual estimate. The new upper route no longer requires an unproved absorption of the signed profile energy.
